stories.completionNotes: System Status card + system-status emitter SHIPPED. EMITTER (new src/pi/splash/system_status_emitter.py, mirrors the F-103 shutdown_state_emitter seam): buildSystemStatusState (pure A-3 schema -- obdLink{state,retries,lastSeenS}/sync{lastOkTs,rows,pending,stale}/power{mode,source}/drive{state,driveId}/ts) + makeSystemStatusEmitter(statesDir, *, syncStaleThresholdS, nowIsoFn) -> best-effort emit(**live readings) that computes stale + writes atomically (reuses ensureStatesDir/writeStateAtomic; write failure logged-never-raised so the dashboard hook never blocks the orchestrator loop) + isSyncStaleWhileDriving(driveState, lastOkTs, nowIso, *, thresholdS) policy helper. A-3 OWNERSHIP: the orchestrator/sync tier owns the emitter (holds live BT-link + sync_log + DriveDetector state) and CALLS emit(...) -- unidirectional, same as power_watch->shutdown emitter; the emitter never reaches back. HONEST-INSTRUMENT: obdLink.state reported verbatim (linked/reconnecting/down), never fabricated 'linked'; absent/unparseable last-sync while recording -> stale (never claim unprovable freshness). THRESHOLD: syncStaleThresholdS is a REQUIRED factory param (Spool S-3 owns the value, config supplies it) -- NO hardcoded tuning number (Refusal Rule 2 / PM Rule 7). CARD (carousel.js): added pure node-testable render logic exported on `api` -- obdLinkTile/syncTile/powerTile/driveTile (each -> {label,value,detail,level}), btGlyphState/syncGlyphState/powerGlyphState, systemStatusView(data) (non-object -> null). F-1 cardinal rule: a tile/glyph is `ok`(green) ONLY when the underlying state is genuinely good; down/reconnecting/stale/battery -> amber/down/neutral, never green. DOM render (browser-only): renderSystemStatusCard fills the card-body via textContent (verbatim, no innerHTML) + binds the top-bar glyph data-state; resetSystemGlyphs returns glyphs to neutral on unavailable (no lingering stale-green). I-033: reconnecting -> tile RECONNECTING + retries + amber BT glyph, surfaced within the 4Hz poll (<=2s). dashboard.css: .tile + [data-level=ok/amber/down/unavailable] value colours bound to the palette. Rule-10: specs/architecture.md F-092 section gained a 'System Status card + system-status emitter (US-400)' subsection (A-3 ownership, I-033 visibility, F-1 honest render, I-4 stale-while-driving + Spool-S-3 threshold). GATES (BENCH per validationMethod): tests/pi/splash/test_system_status_emitter.py 9 passed (A-3 shape, honest down-link verbatim, stale policy x5, atomic write + computed-stale, never-raise); tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py 24 passed incl. new US-400 node-logic test (S-3 malformed->null, I-3 RECONNECTING+amber BT glyph, I-4 stale-sync amber, F-1 degraded-never-green + healthy-IS-green positive control + missing-subobject->unavailable) + CSS tile-level assertion + carousel.js node --check (S-1). Full tests/pi/splash + tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit = 0 regressions (1 skip = node/bash gate). ruff clean on all touched .py. stories.goal: As the operator, I want an HONEST view of the Pi UPS battery's health (not the car battery), so I know it can shut down cleanly -- without being lied to by voltage-as-percent or stale-green.
stories.completionNotes: Battery Health card + battery-health emitter SHIPPED -- symmetric to US-400, reuses the F-103/US-400 emitter seam + the carousel's reserved battery-health dispatch slot. EMITTER (new src/pi/splash/battery_health_emitter.py): buildBatteryHealthState (pure A-3 schema per design-spec §7: vcellV/soc/socCalibrated/crate/charging/draining/restedVcellV/weakEvents30d/restedHistory/health/fullChargeReached/runtimeToCutoffS/ambientTempC/lastHealthCheckTs/ladder/ts) + makeBatteryHealthEmitter(statesDir,*,nowIsoFn)->best-effort emit(**live readings) (atomic write via reused ensureStatesDir/writeStateAtomic, logged-never-raised so the dashboard hook never blocks the orchestrator) + HEALTH_GREEN/ATTN/LOW verdict constants. A-3 OWNERSHIP: the orchestrator/power tier owns+calls the emitter (holds live MAX17048 + battery_health_log history + power-watch draining state) -- unidirectional, same seam as system_status/shutdown emitters; the emitter never reaches back. F-11: cell labeled 'Pi UPS battery' never vehicle/car. TWO RENDER-BREAKING TRAPS LOCKED: (F-8 voltage-is-not-percent) the emitter has NO code path from vcellV->soc; soc passes through verbatim (null when the MAX17048 register read is unavailable) -- the trap is locked by ABSENCE, structurally cannot lerp a percent from voltage. (A-6 no-false-failsafe) buildBatteryHealthState forces ladder=None whenever draining is false EVEN IF a caller supplies one -- enforced in the pure builder (the SSOT) so a buggy caller can't light a phantom drain (the D-2 dishonest-instrument trap). SPOOL-OWNED (NO hardcode, Refusal Rule 2): the live runtime-remaining (S-2) + ladder thresholds (3.70/3.55/3.45 V) are failsafe-only and arrive inside the caller's `ladder` dict; the emitter/render NEVER fabricate them -- a draining pack with no Spool data shows stage+volts only, no minutes. CARD (carousel.js): pure node-testable exports on `api` -- batteryHealthView(data) (non-object->null) + healthCheckLine/vcellTile/socTile/tempTile/ladderView. F-8: socTile renders the percent ONLY when soc is a real number (tagged (uncalibrated) when socCalibrated false); null soc -> shown:false, vcellTile shows '3.44 V' (volts, never '%'). F-9 stale-green guard: healthCheckLine computes age from ts-lastHealthCheckTs (both in the state file -> deterministic/node-testable, no browser-clock dep); a GREEN verdict ALWAYS carries 'last health check . <date> (<age>)' inline in health.detail. F-10: tempTile null -> 'not captured', never a number. F-2/A-6: ladderView returns null unless draining true; the DOM render appendLadder only fires when view.ladder!==null. DOM renderBatteryHealthCard fills card-body via textContent (verbatim, no innerHTML); tick() dispatches battery-health -> renderBatteryHealthCard (battery-health slot now wired, was reserved by US-399/400). dashboard.css: .ladder failsafe block (amber border, TRIGGER stage escalates to --red-light) appended only during a drain; battery tiles reuse the US-400 .tile/[data-level] styling. Rule-10: specs/architecture.md F-092 section gained a 'Battery Health card + battery-health emitter (US-401)' subsection (A-3 ownership, F-8 locked-by-absence, F-9 ts-based age, F-10, A-6 builder-enforced no-false-failsafe, Spool S-2 owed, C-5 third states-dir writer). GATES (BENCH per validationMethod): tests/pi/splash/test_battery_health_emitter.py 8 passed (A-3 shape, F-8 soc-null verbatim, A-6 ladder-forced-null-when-not-draining + preserved-when-draining + no-Spool-data-stays-null, atomic write + invariant, draining writes ladder, never-raise); tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py +2 (US-401 node-logic test F-8 volts-not-percent + soc-shown positive control + F-9 45-day age on GREEN + F-10 not-captured + F-2/A-6 draining gates + no-fabricated-minutes + F-11 UPS-not-vehicle label; CSS .ladder/TRIGGER assertion) = 36 passed; full tests/pi/splash + tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit = 0 regressions (1 skip = node/bash gate). carousel.js node --check green (via test_carouselJs_passesNodeSyntaxCheck_s1). ruff clean on all touched .py. DEFERRED (Pi bench, per validationMethod): I-6 (pull wall power on the UPS rig while parked -> card escalates to ladder + runtime <=2s) = live UPS-drain drill at sprint validation + the orchestrator/power call-site wiring that feeds emit(...) live MAX17048/health-log/draining readings (live integration on the Pi; the unit + display are tested + ready -- same deferral pattern as US-399 boot-handoff + US-400 BT-drop). DEFERRED-PM: mypy (not on dev box; code mypy-strict-shaped -- full hints, future annotations, no untyped defs) + full `pytest tests/` (slow SMB; the two scoped suites are the in-iteration gate). NEXT: US-402 (pygame sunset -- retire status_display.py/dashboard_layout.py once the HTML carousel reaches parity, A-4) now that BOTH cards (US-400 System Status + US-401 Battery Health) are at parity; or US-403 (System Setup menu, deps US-399). DTC line US-404->405+406->407 still pending.
